content.text:
I submitted index 10 (Sb fraction 0.49) as the best composition. It had the highest measured EQE, 0.00169%, but every point I measured was near zero, so it isn't a clear winner. All 5 EQE measurements are used, and none of the 5 XRD measurements were used.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0.22 | 0.00062 |
| 5 | 0.33 | 0.00105 |
| 10 | 0.49 | 0.00169 |
| 15 | 0.65 | −0.00064 |
| 22 | 0.80 | 0.00035 |

- **Why the values are so low:** the likely reason is that the Zn–Sb oxides on this line have band gaps well above the 2.4 eV illumination, so they absorb very little. Known values for ZnSb2O6 and Zn7Sb2O12 are about 3.3 eV or more.
- **Band-gap model disagreed:** the band-gap model put both of those phases near 1.95 eV and Zn3Sb2O7 at about 0 eV. I didn't trust those numbers, and the measurements don't support them.
- **Coverage:** I spread the measurements across the whole line rather than following the curve-fitting suggestion, because the early readings gave it nothing to work with. I measured 5 of the 28 compositions, so a narrow high-EQE point between them could have been missed.
